correctness.rationale: Finite Weyl orthogonality diagonalizes the full projector orbit with singular values sqrt(N)|A_z(a,b)|. For 0<|z|!=1 the split geometric-series numerator has two terms whose modulus balance requires r^(2a)=r^N; hence zero only when N even, a=N/2, with parity of b selected by the real sign of z^N. For |z|=1 the constant-phase split yields exactly gcd(a,N)-1 nonzero-modulation zeros per a, plus the even half-cycle sign correction; z=0 is handled directly. Differentiating the resonant half-translation numerator yields the individual linear slopes, and other finite singular values remain bounded below, giving the sharp condition-number limit. Independently computed ambiguity sums for N=2..6 and four parameter types each (20 cases) matched all piecewise rank formulas, including ray/unit-circle branches. This is finite corroboration of the analytic proof, not uniform large-N stability.
residual_risks: No assertion on rank-deficient nonlinear vector phase retrieval, arbitrary windows, full spark, or N-uniform near-resonance asymptotics.
